thesis: India's largest mid-segment hosiery maker (~15% of the organised market) that cannot convert profit into cash. FY26: PAT Rs 106cr but CFO -Rs 149cr — the second straight year of negative operating cash flow — while debtor days stretched to 140 and short-term borrowings doubled to Rs 578cr. The engine trips three independent quality vetoes (E2 two-year cash conversion, E6 140-day receivables with negative CFO, D4 Piotroski 2/9) on filed consolidated data and excludes it. The anchor prints FV Rs 1,571 with the price 26% below it, but that FV rides the bare-schema 15% margin fallback against a 6.1% reality — the apparent cheapness is an artifact. A live three-way demerger (47% of revenue leaving the listed entity) adds a comparability break on top. Passing is the right call until cash collection is proven.
